description: Unofficial fan art of Luo Tianyi from Vsinger, with grey loop-braided hair, teal accessories and an original modest white-and-teal long-sleeve outfit over opaque leggings. Nine animations feature microphone singing, sleeve-tapped melody, a microphone-switch hiccup and recovery, a steamed-bun snack, foot-tapped waiting, three-direction running and a lively jump. Clothing and choreography are creative adaptations, not an exact official costume or performance.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
